intro: The **Company Switcher initializer** configures the drop-in for managing multi-company contexts in B2B storefronts. Use initialization to customize company context management, header injection, session persistence, and GraphQL module integration.

langDefinitions.description: Language definitions for internationalization (i18n). Override dictionary keys for localization or branding.

companyHeader.description: HTTP header name for company identification. Defaults to `'X-Adobe-Company'`.

customerGroupHeader.description: HTTP header name for customer group identification. Defaults to `'Magento-Customer-Group'`.

companySessionStorageKey.description: Session storage key for persisting company context. Defaults to `'DROPIN__COMPANYSWITCHER__COMPANY__CONTEXT'`.

groupSessionStorageKey.description: Session storage key for persisting group context. Defaults to `'DROPIN__COMPANYSWITCHER__GROUP__CONTEXT'`.

fetchGraphQlModules.description: GraphQL modules that will have company headers applied. Defaults to `[]`.

groupGraphQlModules.description: GraphQL modules that will have group headers applied. Defaults to `[]`.
